courses.overview: 從幾何變換、光照與 GPU 管線同步延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。

related.why: 共同處理取樣與座標轉換
related.transfer: 共同處理取樣與座標轉換
related.difference: 渲染生成影像，機器視覺估計物理屬性
related.differenceEn: Rendering generates images; vision estimates properties

place.name: Microsoft Research 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「機器視覺檢測系統」共用的資料／元件介面；以「共同處理取樣與座標轉換」指出能保留的條件。
針對「渲染生成影像，機器視覺估計物理屬性」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with machine-vision inspection systems; use "Both handle sampling and coordinates" to identify retained conditions.
For "Rendering generates images; vision estimates properties", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

courses.summary: 三維渲染引擎從幾何變換、光照與 GPU 管線同步連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Three-dimensional rendering engines connects interfaces, data and acceptance through geometry transforms, lighting and gpu pipeline synchronization. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「世界座標」到「渲染驗收」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect world coordinates to rendering acceptance, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: Vulkan 明確分開執行與記憶體依賴；課程用自製三角形和波形呈現原理，不復制官方圖。
history.textEn: Vulkan separates execution and memory dependencies; original triangles and timelines explain principles without copying official figures.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
